scope: October 13, 2025 common Law, Standard Setup, four base factions, Fall/Autumn and Winter, one base Thief/Tinker/Ranger Vagabond, dominance and coalitions.
excluded: Expansion systems, second Vagabond, other characters/maps, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.
method: Exact current-byte audit of frozen expanded-iteration-02. Compared both assigned complete summary snapshots; the diff consists only of the five revision areas (including the Alliance operations procedure table) identified in checked_claims. Each changed statement was checked directly against applicable authoritative PDF Law wording; unchanged passages retain the independent complete-source review. Current authoritative source hashes were recomputed and are unchanged. No questions, keys, reader responses, grades or other reviews were read. Previous reports preserved and summaries not edited.

checked_claims.details: The table correctly describes one operation at a time: one normal move, one battle, one warrior in one base clearing, or remove one Alliance warrior in an unsympathetic clearing to place sympathy and score. Any order and repetition is allowed within the total officer limit. Operations do not remove officers. Organize has no supporter payment, adjacency prerequisite or Martial Law cost, while legal placement still applies. Draw one plus bonuses and discard follow operations.

Counting face-up tea before refreshing is equivalent to the Law exclusion of tea flipped face up during the step: two exhausted items per initially face-up tracked tea, then three more. This does not repair damage.
Emphasized normal Move restriction correctly permits only exit to adjacent clearings and forbids forest entry; free Slip exceptions remain stated separately.
Aid remains legal to Hostile recipients and may acquire their crafted items, but Aid cannot improve a Hostile relationship. Non-Hostile improvement still follows the full same-turn thresholds below.

checked_claims.area: Forced bird suit treatment and quantity
checked_claims.details: A prompted give/discard of a non-bird suit requires birds to be treated as that suit. Treating birds as matching does not increase the number of cards specified by the instruction. The summary retains no reverse substitution for an explicit bird requirement.
Edition and component counts/types; item and faction ownership; exclusions.
